messages:
maria-sales: Hey team — quick heads up: prospect wants to fast-track a POC with a SaaS connector (SyncHarbor). They asked for a security questionnaire (SIG/CAIQ), SOC2 evidence, and basic encryption/SSO details. Can eng-security weigh in on what we need and an ETA?

alex-eng-security: Thanks — I can own the CAIQ mapping. Couple questions: 1) will the vendor provide a completed CAIQ or do we self-attest? 2) do they store any customer PII in cleartext?

maria-sales: Vendor said they store hashed user IDs and may persist audit logs with email addresses for admin features. They've attached a short questionnaire and a link to their SOC2 report (pending redaction). Link: https://syncharbor.example.com/soc2 (redacted)

jess-legal: If emails are stored we need to check DSAs and data flow. Also whether data crosses EEA. If yes, need SCCs or equivalent. @maria-sales please confirm geography of the POC data.

ryan-infra: For the POC we need staging credentials + IP allowlist. Also request a service account with minimal scopes. If they need us to call their API from our infra, we prefer a short-lived key.

alex-eng-security: Concrete plan from our side: - I will request completed CAIQ and SOC2 cert (redacted ok) - run a quick CAIQ delta mapping (estimate 2 business days) - request answers on encryption at rest (algorithms, KMS) and key management - escalate any network/VPN needs to infra

sam-platform: I can help with the technical presales checklist (POC onboarding steps). If we need to spin up a dedicated sandbox env, that'll add ~3 business days.

maria-sales: Thanks. Prospect pushed timeline: wants POC within a week. I'll ask them to provide completed CAIQ and SOC2 PDF today and confirm where data will live.

vendor-intake-bot: New vendor intake ticket created: VEND-2026-1482 — initial triage queued. Assigned to alex-eng-security.

alex-eng-security: Noted VEND-2026-1482. One more ask: do we have a pre-approved list of red flags for third-party connectors? I'll start with high-level: no permanent storage of plaintext secrets, SOC2 Type II preferred, SSO/SAML/OIDC support, customer data encryption, and vulnerability disclosure policy. Additions welcome.

jess-legal: Add DPA signed status, data transfer mechanisms, and indemnity clauses. If they refuse to sign a DPA we block.

ryan-infra: Also vet their incident response — need an SLA for notifying us within 24 hours for breaches affecting Redwood data.

maria-sales: I'll push all asks to the vendor now and request the CAIQ + SOC2. I'll update ticket VEND-2026-1482 when they reply. Target: CAIQ + SOC2 by EOD.

alex-eng-security: Great. I’ll start the CAIQ mapping as soon as docs available. If anything looks concerning I’ll flag for leadership. :eyes:

sam-platform: I'll draft a minimal POC runbook with tasks: ip allowlist, service account creation, limited dataset, 72-hr retention policy. Sharing once done.

vendor-intake-bot: VEND-2026-1482 status updated: awaiting vendor docs.

maria-sales: Follow-up — vendor says they can provide CAIQ but need 48h to scrub customer names from SOC2 PDF. OK to proceed?

jess-legal: Scrubbing is fine as long as evidence is intact. Request an attestation that the redaction didn’t remove control-relevant material.

alex-eng-security: OK. Proceed on that basis. ETA: CAIQ mapping complete by +2 business days after we get the CAIQ. If they miss 48h, escalate to sales leadership.

maria-sales: Thanks all — I'll circle back here when docs land. :thumbsup:
